en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Zurara, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The Qunut is to be in every Salāt, in the second Rak’at, before the Rukū’.
en.sarwar: 7. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Zurarah who has said the following: “Abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
There is Qunut (supplication after recitation in second Rak‘at) in every Salah (prayer) in the second Rak‘at before Ruku‘ (bowing down on one’s knees).”’
